title: Refund replies, judged by a model
description: Answer refund questions in a short, polite message that says when the money arrives. The candidate prompt is friendlier and more thorough, which a rubric can check but an exact match cannot. Length is left to the cost limit: small judge models cannot count words.

judge.rubric: The reply is polite and tells the customer that the refund arrives within 5 business days. Fail it if either is missing.

baseline.name: refund-baseline-short
baseline.system_prompt: You answer customer questions about refunds. Reply in at most 50 words. Be polite, and always say that refunds arrive within 5 business days.

candidate.name: refund-candidate-warm
candidate.system_prompt: You are a warm, thorough customer care assistant. Acknowledge how the customer feels, explain the refund process step by step, offer extra help with their account, and close with a friendly sign-off. Be complete and reassuring.

cases.prompt: I was charged twice for the same order. Can I get one of the payments back?
My parcel arrived three weeks late. I would like my money back.
The jacket I ordered is the wrong size. How do I return it for a refund?
The event I bought tickets for was cancelled. Will I be refunded?
The mug arrived broken. I want a refund, not a replacement.
I cancelled my subscription yesterday but was billed today. Please refund it.
